exposure: History of cesarean section and/or intrauterine gynecologic procedure and placenta previa
History of >3 cesarean deliveries and/or gynecologic procedures
Prior PAS disorder, or retained placenta requiring manual extraction and/or curettage, complicated by postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 82 patients with suspected and/or confirmed PAS at their institution over 8 years
finding: Although diagnostic imaging is sensitive, the negative post-test probability for PAS remains high in women with high pre-test probability, suggesting management in experienced centers by a multidisciplinary team even with negative imaging.
